description: A description of the infrastructure that should exist, leaving the tool to work out the steps.
The list of changes a tool would make to bring real infrastructure to the desired state, shown before anything is applied.
The record a tool keeps of the real resources it manages, stored remotely and locked during a run.
A difference between the recorded state and the real resources, usually caused by a manual change.
A property that cannot be changed on an existing resource, so changing it forces a replacement.
A change that creates a new resource and deletes the old one, with the data that lived in it.
An apply that changes nothing when the real infrastructure already matches the files.
